Unrelated to other products named Hunch. A working name for a prototype.
Internal package names, protocol constants and storage names still say \'dhyan\' so existing data and pairings keep working.
Hunch tracks scroll counts and app switches to model your attention. It never reads screen content.
Hunch attention monitoring runs in the foreground

Hunch uses this optional service solely on-device to detect which foreground app is active during user-initiated focus sessions. Hunch never reads screen text, keystrokes, or personal content, and never transmits data off your local network.
Hunch Accessibility — monitors app switches only. No screen content is read.
